column1: # German (de) catalog for Craft Unofficial Launcher.
# Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of Craft Unofficial Launcher's English labels in neutral German,
# using the terms German-speaking users of creative software know. The user is addressed with
# the informal "du", as in most current creative and community software.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: the product name "Craft Unofficial Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag),
# app names (which come from each app's own descriptor) and "GitHub".
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
